stories.title: Tarmac seek permission to fix fault line issue after Hendre Quarry land slip
stories.summary: A limestone quarry which sits on a fault line in Flintshire which caused a land slip could be stabilised if owners Tarmac are granted planning permission. stories.title: Mold café The Gathering announces immediate closure
stories.summary: The Gathering Coffee Shop & Bistro in Mold has closed permanently with immediate effect. The town centre café announced the closure in a post to customers titled “A Difficult Goodbye”. The café’s page describes it as Business of the Year at the Mold Community Awards in 2024. stories.title: Planning officer rejects defibrillator outside Mold building society over listed building setting
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has refused Nationwide permission for a defibrillator and bleed kit cabinet on the front of its Mold branch, ruling the defibrillator would harm the setting of the Grade II listed building next door. stories.title: Transport for Wales brings bus network proposals to Mold, Deeside, Flint and Holywell this month
stories.summary: People in Flintshire can question Transport for Wales about its proposed new bus network at four drop-in sessions this month, starting at Mold Library and Museum on Wednesday. stories.title: Wales has had its warmest summer on record, Met Office says
stories.summary: Wales has provisionally had its warmest summer since records began, with a mean temperature of 16.9°C, the Met Office has said.
